news.body:
## What moved
- The visa is physically back, and last week's whole risk list went with it.
You submitted at VFS Delhi on Tuesday the 10th despite not having the Etudes en France printout Delhi said was mandatory, the embassy finished with the file on Friday morning, and the centre had it ready for collection by Friday evening. Three days, start to finish.
- You cleared four other things while that was in the post.
The apostille and attestation closed on the 9th, the Google Strategy and Operations application went in the same morning, the Amazon Launch assessment and the first CDC coaching session both on the 8th, and the Kraft Heinz CV yesterday within the hour.
## What did not
- The KITAS is a week past expiry with nothing confirmed either way.
Unchanged since you set it on the 11th. Chitra's revised quotation has been outstanding since mid-October and you have now left the country, so the question is no longer renew or cancel but what the lapse costs.
- Club 8 is dated today and has not moved since the 9th.
What the room comes with and when you can take the keys are both still open, and from tomorrow your days are gone.
- Nothing has touched the euro account or the French health cover since early October.
Both read Upcoming behind the tuition, which is fair, and both have dates inside the next four weeks.
## Risks
- The extension was granted against an outcome that has now arrived, and nobody on the other side knows.
INSEAD would not write SBI the refund undertaking and offered to wait for the visa instead. The visa decision is sitting in a building in Delhi. The moment you open it, the 53,000 euro instalment stops being blocked and becomes a nine-day deadline, and SBI needs lead time to disburse. Telling Marie Rose and the branch the same day you collect is what keeps that from being a scramble.
- Next week is not a working week.
Business Foundations runs 12:30 to 19:00 your time every day from tomorrow to Friday. Everything dated inside it - the passport, the Harver application, the Career Anchor scores on the 23rd, the KITAS on the 22nd - has evenings and nothing else. That is the real reason today matters more than usual.
- If the sticker's dates are not what you assumed, you want to know on Monday and not in January.
The entry date and the validity drive the Fontainebleau flight, the ANEF validation and the housing dates. It is the one fact this board has been guessing at for six weeks.
## Put first this week
- Collect the passport on Monday, and read the sticker before you leave the counter.
- Then the two mails: Marie Rose on where the visa stands, and one call to Chitra on the KITAS.
- Club 8 today, and Rodolfo's Finance chapters tonight - Session 1 wants them read before Monday's class.
